name: daily-sentry-error-review
description: Daily Sentry error review — new issues, regression detection, and release health check.
prompt: Check Sentry for new issues in last 24h across eushop-web and eushop-api projects. Identify any errors with > 10 occurrences. Check for regressions (issues that appeared after last deploy). Review release health score. Alert on any FATAL or CRITICAL level new errors. Generate daily error health report.
